once, throwing an error naming the tool for a schema ajv cannot

ToolDefinitionSource still resolves per call with compiled validators
cached by schema object in a WeakMap, so a changed schema takes
effect on its next call.

the default import of the CJS package is what broke typecheck on the
last push — and drops the ErrorObject import in favour of the
ValidateFunction error shape. Rewrites registry.test.ts around the
unit criteria (register-time throw, WeakMap freshness, extra-property
passthrough, wrong-type naming, unknown-tool pin), which also clears
the no-duplicate-code clone of the acceptance test, and restructures
the acceptance generator to the early-return shape with the member
chain split.
